UN.wiki: An intergovernmental organization whose stated purposes are to maintain international peace and security and coordinate planetary diplomatic communications.

DEFCON.wiki: An alert state used by the United States Armed Forces. DEFCON 1 represents maximum readiness, indicating immediate imminent global conflict.

USA.wiki: The foremost economic and military superpower, mobilizing global armed forces in response to the extraterrestrial invasion.

EU.wiki: A political and economic union of 27 member states located primarily in Europe, coordinating continental civil defence and air response.

UK.wiki: A sovereign country in Europe operating key Royal Air Force radar facilities and early-warning listening posts across the North Atlantic.

NORAD.wiki: The combined United States and Canadian organization that provides aerospace warning, air sovereignty, and defense for Northern America, tracking extraterrestrial craft approaching planetary orbit.

POTUS.wiki: The Commander-in-Chief of the US Armed Forces, responsible for authorizing nuclear launches, alien counter-strikes, and national emergency mobilizations.

Area 51.definition: Homey Airport / Groom Lake Secret Testing Facility
Area 51.wiki: A highly classified United States Air Force facility within the Nevada Test and Training Range, long rumored to conceal captured extraterrestrial technology and wreckage.

EMP.wiki: Intense bursts of electromagnetic radiation capable of incapacitating terrestrial electrical networks, aircraft avionics, and telecommunications satellites.

USAF.wiki: The aerial warfare branch of the US Armed Forces, deploying advanced combat jets (such as F-18s, F-15s, and F-22s) to engage extraterrestrial city-destroyer craft.

ICBM.wiki: Land-based, rocket-propelled strategic ballistic missiles capable of delivering thermonuclear warheads against global and high-altitude targets.
